title: AHFC Agenda Items Pushed to May 18
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) board met to discuss two key housing-related agenda items.
*   Due to an "advertising error," the board was unable to take action on these items as scheduled.
*   All decisions concerning these two housing items have been postponed to the May 18th meeting.
*   A public hearing for these items was opened but will remain open until the next meeting on May 18th.
